info.title: S1 Identity & Partner Service REST API
info.description: Identity, partner applications, courier profiles and merchant API credentials. Contract paths are gateway paths.

get.description: Returns the profile for the token subject; no user id is accepted. Allowed roles: CUSTOMER, MERCHANT, COURIER, DISPATCHER.

403.description: Authenticated caller lacks an allowed role or resource permission

503.description: Service or required dependency is unavailable

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation identifier: 1-128 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit. Missing, duplicate or invalid values are replaced with a UUID; the accepted ID is returned in the response header.
